summary: Remaining metrics and the simultaneous guarantee. (a) Equalized-odds gap: for each hospital and the methods local, pooled, certified pooled (eps 0.01, delta 0.015), the larger of the absolute difference in true-positive rate and in false-positive rate between the two sex groups at the threshold that flags the top 10% of the hospital's test patients by predicted risk. (b) Communication cost: bytes per round and total for FedAvg/FedProx (30 rounds x 53 coefficients as 8-byte floats up and down per hospital) and for the certificate (two scalars per candidate). (c) Paired test across hospitals: Wilcoxon signed-rank test of certified vs local and pooled vs local loss differences, over the 126 hospitals, per seed. (d) Simultaneous guarantee: the certification step rerun with alpha divided by the number of hospitals (Bonferroni), reporting how many hospitals are still moved off local.

summary: Fairness baselines Ditto (Li et al., ICML 2021) and q-FFL (Li et al., ICLR 2020) for logistic regression.
